message.content:
An Indonesian magazine cover from February 2018 features a digital painting of a man with disheveled black hair and thin-rimmed glasses. He wears a light-colored, button-down shirt. His hands are positioned in front of him; his right hand holds a lit match to a small, dark metal chalice, which rests on a surface out of frame. The man’s face is illuminated by the match’s yellow flame. A red-and-white ribbon is draped over his wrists.

Large, dark gray letters at the top center spell "TEMPO." Above this, smaller text reads "ORANG GILA PENYERANG ULAMA" and "DILAN DAN PENGGOMBAL MILENIAL." Below the main title is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." On the right, white block letters with a motion-blur effect read "KALANG KABUT ASIAN GAMES." Smaller text below explains government actions regarding the sports event. A barcode and technical details are in the bottom right corner, including the date "19-25 FEBRUARI 2018." The background consists of a solid red vertical stripe on the left and a muted blue-to-yellow gradient.
